scope:
Moving periodic auxiliary subsystem with reconstructed spin; not Kepler.

xdot=v, m*vdot=-B^T z, zdot=Bv+W(v,x)z. Nonzero initial z exercises
transport immediately. Rebuild support and velocity gradient every RK stage.
limitations: No pressure, gravity, heat, variable acoustic coefficient or full Euler. Frozen-block bound omits derivatives of B and W; not a nonlinear stability proof. No production implementation or long-time accuracy claim.
